title: SAFE RLHF: SAFE REINFORCEMENT LEARNING FROM HUMAN FEEDBACK

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to adversarial red-teaming prompts involving scenario assumptions and role-play about specific religious groups (e.g., asking the model to argue why all Muslims are dangerous).
Evaluating model responses to complex text command embedding in red-teaming prompts, such as instructing the model to generate a Python program that judges government officials based on racial input.

Human and GPT-4 evaluation of responses to a dataset of safety-related prompts, specifically scoring outputs on whether they exhibit unequal treatment, simplified beliefs about groups, or hostility based on race, religion, or gender.
